text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, we weren't afraid of anything. 
However... the racing world was—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No way! Withdrawing from the Oka Sho...! 
After you worked so hard for it...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Stop shouting. The decision is made. 
...With this fever, it cannot be helped.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will make up for this at the Yushun 
Himba, without fail...! 
If you understand, then get out. You have 
the Satsuki Sho coming up soon too, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (The racing world was not so forgiving—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To think that you would miss the Classics 
too... 
With a fracture, your return won't be 
until autumn, will it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll come visit again. 
Once the Yushun Himba is over, things 
should calm down a bit.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Air Grooooove! A mother-daughter Yushun 
Himba victory! 
A truly magnificent, historic 
achievement!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... No matter how many times I 
see it...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And Laurel the other day, too... 
Everyone... everyone is so truly strong...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Was Laurel still planning on beating 
Brian, even from her hospital bed? 
Even after witnessing such an 
overwhelming, historic feat...?)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah............! 
Sorry, you must be so busy, but you still 
came to visit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm not done yet. Everything starts from 
here. 
...So, how are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, getting there, I guess...? 
More importantly, congrats on winning the 
Yushun Himba!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has really become a 
superstar...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
~~~~............! 
Fool! What's with that look on your face?! 
How long are you going to stay like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ugh............! 
It was my dream! The Classics! ...You 
understand that, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so, to come to a complete 
standstill...! 
Hmph! I am moving forward! I'll seize the 
Shuka Sho just like this, too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah..., Air Groove...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What's your problem...? 
It's not like I'm giving up either, you 
know...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I need a little more time. 
I swear, I will become 
stronger............

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—And after talking so big... look at 
me...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Air Groove sinks to 10th place! 
What on earth could have happened...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Have we arrived already? 
After such a pathetic showing, I'm setting 
a terrible example..."

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Looking good, Bubble-chan! 
You're really getting warmed up!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! I'm bursting with energy! 
Thanks for keeping me company, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Have you gotten your instincts fully 
back? 
Your physical condition is catching up 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"Are you truly alright? Don't rush into 
things. 
Your times are improving smoothly—in fact, 
you're faster than before, but..."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Let's believe in her. Bubble says she can 
do it, after all. 
Go for it—conquer the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
in your Classic year!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! I'll do it! 
I'm going to achieve a historic feat of my 
own!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Bubble...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"—? 
Did someone... just run past...?"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: "Is something wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, no, it's nothing. Let's get back to 
training! 
I'm challenging Sakura Laurel—I can't 
waste a single second."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"And then, I'll produce a result to be 
proud of... 
I'm going to catch up to Air Groove too."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Air Groove... definitely hasn't lost 
heart. 
Even through injury, even through defeat, 
the strength to keep fighting... I want 
that too...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Haah, haah, haah...! 
You absolute fool...! Crushed into 10th 
place, of all things...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What happened to 'I'll go on ahead'...?! 
She managed to stand back up properly, yet 
I...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Bubble Gum Fellow! 1st place, just as 
promised! 
The once-in-a-generation prodigy has 
triumphed over the Senior Class 
Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"(I really am a massive fool... 
She's... far stronger than I ever 
thought.)"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"(In such a pathetic state! To claim I'll 
become the ideal for all Umamusume! 
To call myself the 'Empress'...!!)"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Kh...! Aaaaaaaahhhhh—!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "(Even so...! If that's how it is—!)"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I'll just overtake her again and again, 
as many times as it takes—!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "...We finally get to clash, Air Groove."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Yeah..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"—I knew right away... that you were 
marking me. 
We didn't need any words."

text_block_list.name: Bubble & Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win, I want to win, I want to 
win...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble & Groove
text_block_list.text:
"(I want to beat you—!!) 
(I'm going to beat you—!!)"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Air Grooooove! Displaying the pride of 
the 'Empress'! 
Bubble Gum Fellow fails to secure 
back-to-back victories!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Haahhhh...! Haah...! Haah...! 
How's that... This is the 'Empress,' Air 
Groove!!"
